# Agent_Interaction_Sequencing

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The method of arranging pairwise or multi-agent interaction events in a temporal or spatial order to achieve a desired collective behavior with minimal latency. Enables in-network neuromorphic systems to schedule spike-based communications among agents to reduce energy and improve real-time response.
